mil3.3.10:1.4: It perceives blue, it perceives yellow, it perceives red, it perceives white, it perceives crimson.
mil3.3.10:1.5: That, Great King, is how perception has the characteristic of perceiving.”
mil3.3.10:2.2: “Suppose, Great King, the king’s treasurer, having entered the treasury and seen the objects for the king’s use that are blue, yellow, red, white, and crimson, perceives them.
mil3.3.10:2.3: That, Great King, is how perception has the characteristic of perceiving.”
